The '''Declaration of Belcantese Independence''' was proclaimed on 15 May 1949 in [[Belgrad]] as local Vesperan power in Belcanto collapsed during the final phase of the [[Avant Great War]].

== Background ==

Belcanto had been under Vesperan occupation since the end of the [[Belcanto Campaign]]. The [[Belcantese Independence Movement]] used the breakdown of local imperial administration to restore local government and proclaim independence before the war's formal end on 3 December 1949.

== Significance ==

The declaration marked the transition from underground resistance to provisional state authority. It provided the political foundation for the postwar [[Belcanto Nations]] and for later constitutional reconstruction.

== Legacy ==

The declaration became one of the central civic memory points of postwar Belcanto. It connected language restoration, federal reconstruction, and cultural recovery to the end of Vesperan occupation.
